priceNote: Prices in Nepali Rupees. Confirm current prices with the kitchen when ordering — the wall menu in Thamel is always the final word.

categories.name: Signature Soups
categories.blurb: Deep, slow-simmered broths. The reason people walk across Thamel at 2pm.

items.name: Special Kungfu Noodles
items.desc: Rich, spicy broth with chewy hand-pulled noodles and a generous pile of braised buff. Lots of Sichuan pepper, big chunks of meat. The house classic.

items.name: Sichuan Style Noodles
items.desc: Minced meat, fresh vegetables, dried chillies and tongue-tingling Sichuan peppercorns.

items.name: Hot & Sour Noodles
items.desc: Tangy, peppery broth built on black vinegar and white pepper — a Nepali twist on a Sichuan standard.

items.name: Super Spicy Chicken Noodles
items.desc: For the heat-seekers: triple chilli oil, tender chicken and a handful of pak choi to cool you down.

items.name: Buff Noodle Soup
items.desc: Buff bone broth simmered with star anise and ginger, ladled over noodles with tender sliced buff.

items.name: Tomato & Egg Noodles
items.desc: Comfort in a bowl: sweet stewed tomato, silky egg ribbons, scallion, hand-pulled noodles.

items.name: Vegetable Noodle Soup
items.desc: Shiitake stock, garden vegetables and noodles, finished with sesame oil.

items.name: Wonton Noodle Soup
items.desc: Pork-and-chive wontons swimming in a clear noodle broth with bok choy.

categories.name: Dry Noodles
categories.blurb: No broth — just noodles, sauce and a lot of tossing. Order one of each and share.

items.name: Wuhan Style Dry Noodles
items.desc: Dry-tossed noodles in rich sesame paste with pickled mustard tuber, crushed peanuts and fresh veg.

items.name: Special Chinese Dry Noodles
items.desc: Pickled mustard tuber, peanuts, dry noodles and minced meat — the four horsemen, tossed together.

items.name: Zhajiang Noodles
items.desc: Thick wheat noodles under a glossy fermented bean and pork sauce, with shredded cucumber.

items.name: Dan Dan Noodles
items.desc: Minced meat, chilli oil and toasted sesame, tossed hard so every strand is coated.

items.name: Sichuan Cold Noodles
items.desc: Chilled noodles with cucumber, black vinegar and chilli oil — the summer order.

items.name: Chicken Chow Mein
items.desc: Wok-tossed egg noodles with chicken, cabbage and spring onion over a roaring flame.

items.name: Vegetable Chow Mein
items.desc: Same wok, no meat: cabbage, carrot, beansprouts and garlic chives.

categories.name: Appetizers & Cold Sides
categories.blurb: The cold counter that makes locals come back. Order two or three for the table.

items.name: Buff Salad
items.desc: Chilled shredded buff with cucumber, coriander, toasted sesame and chilli oil.

items.name: Pig Ears
items.desc: Super spicy with coriander and raw garlic. A Thamel cult order — you either get it or you don't.

items.name: Buff Tongue
items.desc: Thin-sliced buff tongue, chilli oil, toasted sesame and scallion.

items.name: Preserved Egg
items.desc: Century egg with pickled ginger and black vinegar. Traditional Chinese side dish.

items.name: Black Mushroom Salad
items.desc: Wood ear mushrooms with garlic, black vinegar and coriander.

items.name: Smashed Cucumber
items.desc: Garlic, vinegar and chilli. The perfect cool-down between bowls.

items.name: Fried Egg
items.desc: Crisp-edged with a runny yolk. Add it to anything.

items.name: Spiced Peanuts
items.desc: Toasted peanuts tossed with star anise, chilli and salt.

items.name: Chilli Oil Tofu
items.desc: Silken tofu under house chilli oil, garlic and toasted sesame. Cooling and fiery at once.

items.name: Seaweed Salad
items.desc: Chilled wakame with sesame oil, vinegar and a pinch of sugar.

items.name: Spicy Chicken Feet
items.desc: Boneless, marinated overnight in chilli and black vinegar. Chewy, cold, addictive.

items.name: Sichuan Smashed Potatoes
items.desc: Crisp-edged potato batons tossed with cumin, chilli flakes and Sichuan pepper.

categories.name: Small Eats
categories.blurb: Dumplings and fried things, made to order. Nothing sits under a lamp here.

items.name: Pork & Chive Dumplings
items.desc: Eight pieces, steamed or fried. Ask for the chilli-vinegar dip.

items.name: Vegetable Dumplings
items.desc: Eight pieces with cabbage, shiitake and glass noodle.

items.name: Wontons in Chilli Oil
items.desc: Six pork wontons swimming in house chilli oil and black vinegar.

items.name: Spring Rolls
items.desc: Four crisp rolls with sweet chilli sauce.

items.name: Fried Rice
items.desc: Wok-charred rice with egg and scallion — chicken, buff or vegetable.

items.name: Sesame Balls
items.desc: Three warm, chewy red-bean sesame balls. Best dessert in Thamel, honestly.

items.name: Salt & Pepper Chicken
items.desc: Wok-fried chicken with garlic, fresh chilli and a squeeze of lime.

items.name: Crispy Fried Tofu
items.desc: Golden tofu cubes with a chilli-soy dip and pickled cucumber.

categories.name: Beverages
categories.blurb: Cold, fresh and made to put out the fire.

items.name: Fresh Fruit Juice
items.desc: Pineapple, papaya, mango or watermelon — squeezed to order.

items.name: Iced Lemon Tea
items.desc: Brewed black tea, fresh lemon, plenty of ice.

items.name: Chinese Green Tea
items.desc: A pot of loose-leaf jasmine, refilled all evening.

items.name: Masala Tea
items.desc: Nepali-style milk tea with cardamom and clove.

items.name: Sweet Lassi
items.desc: Thick curd, sugar, a little cardamom. Cooling.

items.name: Soft Drinks & Water
items.desc: Chilled bottles, served with a glass.
